events.title: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix 2026
events.note: The Singapore Grand Prix is renowned for its challenging night race through the Marina Bay Street Circuit, offering a visually stunning spectacle. This event is a highlight in the Formula 1 calendar, attracting fans worldwide.
events.marketing_angle: Experience the thrill of night racing in Singapore's iconic cityscape.
events.why_selected: Formula 1 events are major global sporting spectacles, and the Singapore Grand Prix is particularly renowned for its unique night race format.

events.title: Premier League Mornings Live Fan Festival in Denver
events.note: The Premier League Mornings Live Fan Festival brings the excitement of English football to fans in Denver, Colorado. The event features live broadcasts, appearances by club ambassadors, and interactive activities, offering a unique experience for football enthusiasts.
events.marketing_angle: Join fellow fans in celebrating the Premier League's global community.
events.why_selected: While not in the Czech Republic, this event's international appeal and the global popularity of the Premier League make it noteworthy.

events.title: Il Lombardia 2026
events.note: Il Lombardia, also known as the 'Race of the Falling Leaves,' is one of cycling's five Monuments. This prestigious one-day race in Lombardy, Italy, features challenging climbs and scenic landscapes, attracting top cyclists from around the world.
events.marketing_angle: Witness the culmination of the cycling season in this iconic Italian race.
events.why_selected: Il Lombardia is a significant event in the cycling calendar, drawing attention from enthusiasts globally.

events.title: NFL International Series: Philadelphia Eagles vs. Jacksonville Jaguars
events.note: The NFL International Series brings American football to a global audience. This matchup between the Philadelphia Eagles and the Jacksonville Jaguars is part of the league's initiative to expand its reach beyond the United States.
events.marketing_angle: Witness the excitement of NFL action on an international stage.
events.why_selected: The NFL's global expansion efforts make this event noteworthy, even for international audiences.

events.title: Chicago Marathon 2026
events.note: The Chicago Marathon is one of the six World Marathon Majors, attracting elite runners and amateurs alike. The flat and fast course offers the potential for record-breaking performances, set against the backdrop of Chicago's iconic skyline.
events.marketing_angle: Experience the excitement of one of the world's premier marathons in the heart of Chicago.
events.why_selected: Marathon events have a global following, and the Chicago Marathon is a premier event in the running community.
